title: TRANA pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

neg_control.description: Sample name of the associated negative control; leave empty for negative-control samples
neg_control.errorMessage: Negative control must be a sample name without spaces, or empty for negative-control samples

FW_primer.description: Optional forward primer; leave empty to use the pipeline FW_primer parameter

RV_primer.description: Optional reverse primer; leave empty to use the pipeline RV_primer parameter
